description: Agent development on Adelie: build agent apps on the SDK or connect them to an agent over the Agent API, call any model through one unified LLM API, manage models and secrets, and orchestrate agents, sessions, costs and schedules.
description_zh: 基于 Adelie 的智能体开发：用 SDK 构建应用或经 Agent API 接入智能体、经统一的 LLM API 调用任意模型、管理模型与密钥、编排智能体/会话/成本/定时任务。
short_description: SDK, Agent API, unified LLM API, config and orchestration.
short_description_zh: SDK、Agent API、统一 LLM API、配置与编排。
